entities.name: Nakht
entities.description: Young aven wizard of Naktamun and Tah crop initiate with an affinity for water; drained by a Grim Strider.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Nakht's childhood friend who found a hole in the Hekma.

entities.name: Grim Strider
entities.description: Incredibly tall horror that drained Nakht of life.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City of Amonkhet where the friends grew up.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Named as trespasser in ancient ruins.

entities.name: Tah crop
entities.description: Initiate crop the three were fated to join.

events.summary: At twelve Nakht reveals he is a wizard with an affinity for water.
events.quote: Nakht revealed that he was a wizard and had an affinity for manipulating water.

events.summary: The friends slip through a hole in the Hekma, see a Grim Strider and are attacked by zombies in ancient ruins.
events.quote: were attacked by a swarm of zombies

events.summary: Nakht lures the undead away so Djeru and Samut can escape; the Grim Strider drains him into a soulless husk.
events.quote: draining him of life and leaving him a soulless husk to join the zombie horde

relations.quote: Nakht, Samut and Djeru grew up together
